nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Morning. Two shelters, a fire pit and a hall with half a roof. Pell sits on an upturned bucket, turning a dead radio over in his hands.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Found it in the hall. It's not broken. It's just quiet.

choices.text: What do you think it needs?

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Okay. But later's a real time, right? Not a grown-up later.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: A mast. A tall one. And wire. Lots of wire. The Workshop could make it.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Anyone. Someone's out there. There's always someone.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: A Farm. A Woodcutter. A Workshop. Then the mast.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Dusk. The new Radio Mast creaks in the wind. Pell is under it with the headphones on, far too big for him, turning the dial one click at a time.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: ...Someone's singing. On nine. Lots of someones.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: It's just singing. It's nice. It's... it's the same song. Over and over.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (A choir, very far away. Every voice on the same note, breathing at the same time. Nobody misses a beat.)

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: I'll keep looking. There's got to be somebody who talks.
